name: DC-net pad book end to end, real hardware

raw_source.source: jitterentropy raw time deltas, low 8 bits
raw_source.tool: NIST SP 800-90B ea_non_iid (initial, 8 bits per symbol)
raw_source.note: An earlier single run on a busy machine gave 6.64; idle runs 7.06-7.30. The lowest of three counts, then half of it.

book.alice: kernel XOR Nitrokey XOR extracted jitter, in person

results.short_needle_note: The run's leak check flagged 'bob': 2 occurrences of a 3-byte string in 38.7 MB, against 2.31 expected by chance, in random context; quoted and long forms ('"bob"', 'pair', 'contributions', 'delivery', '"alice"') occur 0 times. The check now uses long or quoted needles only.

harness_bug: The first run fixed its starting round before the slow contribution steps; three minutes later that round was past and padbook refused it (the anti-replay rule). The check was finished on the stored books with the next three current rounds.
limits: One machine, one pair, one day's book; both members simulated on one host and one Nitrokey.
The jitter assessment is SP 800-90B's initial (runtime) estimate; the restart test is not run.
